name: preview-card-1y
title: Preview Card 1y: Blueprint
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. Ruler ticks along two edges and a fine grid in the preview, like a technical drawing.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
